reason: Authorized WP-B successor PR #551 exact head 1ef585650e403ab984c7853378bff55d390ea724 passes Stage WP0, ACV2, WP-B Validation, WP-A post-merge validation, Model Brain Windows and WP-B M2 Contracts, and its Independent Review passes branch authority, source-bound integrity, seal exact-delta, all 116 M2 contracts, all eighteen process-fault scenarios and the local reviewed-head receipt. The only RED is authenticated remote evidence code WP_B_M2_REVIEW_REMOTE_PR_STATE_INVALID because the M2 verifier unconditionally requires historical PR #17 to remain Draft/open/unmerged even when validating an authorized successor branch, although #17 was legitimately merged on 2026-08-18. The M3 verifier contains the same contradictory copied precondition. This work package authorizes only the minimum fail-closed verifier and contract repair so an authorized successor may treat a historical PR as immutable merged evidence while still requiring the current successor PR to be exact-head Draft/open/unmerged. No product source, workflow, receipt, UAT candidate, dependency, routing, database, release artifact or production authority is authorized.

digestCanonicalization.pathNormalization: Require exact repository-relative normalized paths, remove duplicates, then sort with JavaScript default Array.prototype.sort().
digestCanonicalization.canonicalText: Join the normalized sorted unique path list with LF and append exactly one trailing LF before hashing.

targetDefect.requiredProtocol: When the current branch is the original historical WP-B branch, its bound PR must still be Draft/open/unmerged and exact-head. When the current branch is a separately authorized successor, the historical PR may either remain Draft/open/unmerged or be closed because it was actually merged; closed-but-unmerged, open-but-non-Draft, contradictory merged/open states and unrelated refs must fail closed. The current successor PR must independently remain exactly one open Draft unmerged PR on main whose head SHA equals the current validation head.

mandatoryFailureFirstContracts: A successor validation fixture with historical PR state=closed and merged_at set must demonstrate the current false RED before the repair.
The original historical branch must still require its own PR to be Draft/open/unmerged; a merged historical PR cannot authorize new work on the historical branch.
An authorized successor may accept historical evidence only when the historical PR is either Draft/open/unmerged or closed with a non-null merged_at value.
Closed-but-unmerged historical PRs must fail closed.
Open historical PRs that are not Draft must fail closed.
The current successor PR must remain exact-head Draft/open/unmerged on base main; merged or stale successor PRs must still fail.
M2 and M3 remote evidence verifiers must enforce the same historical-state semantics so the copied contradiction cannot recur at the next milestone boundary.
No workflow, review receipt, formal evidence digest, product code, dependency, UAT candidate, release artifact, routing rule or merge authority may be weakened or modified.
The implementation diff must remain exactly the three authorized verifier/test paths.
